name: package-bouncer
description: Checks every package install Claude runs (npm, bun, pnpm, yarn, pip, uv, cargo, go, gem, composer) and stops made-up names, brand-new packages, look-alike names and versions with known security holes.

minAgeDays.title: Minimum age in days
minAgeDays.description: Block a package, or the version being installed, if it was published fewer than this many days ago. 0 turns the age rule off.

minWeeklyDownloads.title: Weekly downloads before a warning
minWeeklyDownloads.description: Add a warning (not a block) when a package had fewer downloads than this last week.

failClosed.title: Block when the registry can't be reached
failClosed.description: Off: an install the bouncer can't check goes ahead with a warning. On: it is blocked.
